summary: End-to-end verification of Jan-2026 session features (customer order stepper, per-order support requests, Widerruf flow, admin phone-order drawer, admin order-status dropdown, admin return-label upload, admin Support tab) plus light regression on Übersicht + Anfragen tabs. 24/24 new backend pytest tests PASS. All frontend playwright flows PASS end-to-end on real preview URL (https://design-322.preview.emergentagent.com) with cookie-based auth preserved. No functional bugs found in new features. Previous iteration_5 report flagged a low-stock banner noise issue (56/56); still unresolved but out of scope for this session.

issues: Drawer backdrop (fixed overlay with bg-black/40) stays mounted until explicitly closed and intercepts tab clicks until the inner × button is used. Minor UX nit (keyboard ESC + backdrop click to close would be nicer), not a bug.

action_items: (Non-blocking) Consider deduplicating session_id: /api/phone-orders/{session_id}/set-password requires session_id BOTH in URL path and in request body (SetInitialPasswordInput model). Body field is effectively redundant.
(Non-blocking, carried over from iteration_5) Low-stock banner shows 56/56 seed products because stock_quantity=0 <= stock_min_alert=0. Filter should require stock_min_alert > 0.
(Minor UX) Admin phone-order drawer should allow closing via ESC key or clicking the dark backdrop; currently requires clicking the × button to avoid intercepting tab clicks underneath.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/admin/phone-orders creates a users row with role 'customer' and NO password_hash the moment the staff submits the phone order, before the customer has paid or confirmed. If the customer never pays, an inactive password-less account remains. Consider soft-deleting these if pending_checkout expires, OR only creating the account on /set-password.

server.py: /api/account/orders/{id}/widerruf rejects orders with status 'NEU' as not-cancellable. Business-wise this is correct (nothing to cancel yet), but the UI's eligibility check mirror in OrderCard.jsx should match; please verify.
server.py: SetInitialPasswordInput requires session_id in body AND path – frontend already passes both, but API shape is inconsistent with other endpoints.

server.py sb_update_order_status: no audit log of status changes. If admin accidentally sets WIDERRUF_ANGEFORDERT or STORNIERT, there is no way to see who/when. Consider an order_status_history table.
OrderCard.jsx widerruf uses window.confirm() – acceptable for admin but ok. For customer-facing flow a styled modal would feel more premium.
server.py /api/staff/support-requests returns raw dict(row) which includes customer_id (uuid). Not sensitive, but consider restricting to needed fields.
